more_info.overview: Thiodipropionic acid is a sulphur-linked dicarboxylic acid, also described as 3,3'-thiodipropionic acid. Its antioxidant function is to slow oxidative deterioration during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
